translations.web: Everyone who sins also commits lawlessness. Sin is lawlessness.
translations.bsb: Everyone who practices sin practices lawlessness as well. Indeed, sin is lawlessness.
translations.kjv: Whosoever committeth sin transgresseth ➔ also the law: for sin is the transgression of the law.
translations.asv: Every one that doeth sin doeth also lawlessness; and sin is lawlessness.
